issues.message: Headline and subheadline appear shifted slightly left compared to the source (source left padding ~80px; variant ~70px). Minor drift, no impact on legibility.

CTA pill sits at the bottom-center rather than horizontally centered with consistent spacing — placement matches the source closely but the pill could use marginally more breathing room above the disclaimer.

notes: Variant is a near-faithful reproduction of the source at the same 1080x1080 format. Composition, palette, type hierarchy, and CTA treatment all preserved. Production-ready.
